result.summary: The residential intersection lacks all basic pedestrian infrastructure, including sidewalks and marked crossings. Pedestrians must walk in the roadway, and sight lines are partially obstructed by trees.

hazards.name: Lack of Sidewalks
hazards.description: No separated walking path exists, forcing pedestrians into the roadway.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The intersection lacks marked crosswalks to guide pedestrians and alert drivers.

hazards.name: Sight Line Obstruction
hazards.description: Large trees and vegetation at the corner may block visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct continuous paved sidewalks to separate pedestrians from traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add marked crosswalks with high-visibility patterns at the intersection.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Trim or remove vegetation near the corner to improve sight lines between all road users.

result.summary: This residential environment lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure, with no sidewalks or marked crossings visible. Pedestrians are forced to share the roadway with vehicles or walk on the grass, which creates a hostile environment despite the likely low traffic speeds.

hazards.name: Lack of Sidewalks
hazards.description: Pedestrians must walk in the roadway or on uneven grass, increasing the risk of vehicle-pedestrian conflict.

hazards.name: Lack of Street Lighting
hazards.description: No visible street lights, which significantly reduces pedestrian visibility and safety during nighttime hours.

hazards.name: Undefined Roadway Edges
hazards.description: The lack of curbs or defined edges can lead to vehicles encroaching on the grass where pedestrians might walk.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a paved sidewalk on at least one side of the street to provide a dedicated, safe space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and personal security after dark.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Implement minor traffic calming measures like speed humps or chicanes to ensure vehicle speeds remain low in this residential area.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a complete lack of dedicated infrastructure, such as sidewalks or marked crosswalks, in a residential setting. Pedestrians are forced to walk in the roadway or on private lawns, creating a high-risk environment for conflict with vehicles.

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalks
hazards.description: Pedestrians have no separated space from vehicular traffic and must walk in the street.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the roadway throughout the scene.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: No designated or protected area for pedestrians to cross the wide intersection.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct paved sidewalks on both sides of the street to provide pedestrian separation from vehicles.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Paint high-visibility crosswalks and install ADA-compliant curb ramps at the intersection to define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to reduce crossing distance and slow turning traffic at the intersection.

result.summary: The intersection lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure, including sidewalks and marked crosswalks, forcing pedestrians to share the roadway with vehicles.
